candidates: Pre-release version identifiers in semver strings must include a dot before the numeric component (e.g., `9.2.1-rc.1`, not `9.2.1-rc1`). Without the dot, identifiers are compared lexicographically, causing `rc10 < rc9`. Verify this format whenever package.json version fields are modified.

When deprecating or removing public-facing config options, API methods, or package exports (including named exports), document the change in the CHANGELOG or release notes—not only via in-code deprecation warnings—so existing consumers have clear migration guidance.

When a feature, config key, or code path is removed or replaced, audit all related JSDoc blocks and inline comments and remove or update any references to the old feature; stale documentation misleads future contributors.

When refactoring to move a callback from a function parameter into an optional property on an interface, verify that existing concrete implementations actually set that property before adding a conditional guard for it in the calling code; if no implementation sets the property, remove the branch rather than leaving dead code.
